_doc: Rewrite the entry point per HbbTV app before TVF loads the address from the AIT (hbbtv.c, hbbweb.c): [regular expression (POSIX ERE), replacement with $1..$9], the first match wins, the rest of the address stays. SRF: the entry page detects the device by its User-Agent; jumping directly into the app selects the player (pb=10: DASH and HLS).
